properties.description:
Dynamic Gold master pipeline.

Flow:
  1. act_list_gold_notebooks  — Databricks notebook reads ev_catalog.gold.gold_control
                                 WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY run_order
                                 exits with: json.dumps([{notebook_name, layer}, ...])
  2. act_foreach_gold         — ForEach (sequential) over the JSON array
     └── act_run_gold_runner  — ExecutePipeline -> pl_gold_runner
                                 passes p_notebook, p_run_date, p_run_type

Dims run before Facts before Marts because run_order controls sequence.
Adding a new Gold notebook = INSERT one row into ev_catalog.gold.gold_control.

activities.name: act_list_gold_notebooks
activities.description:
Read ev_catalog.gold.gold_control WHERE is_active=true ORDER BY run_order.
Returns JSON array string: [{"notebook_name":"nb_gold_dim_station","layer":"dim"}, ...]

activities.name: act_foreach_gold
activities.description:
Iterate sequentially over each active Gold notebook entry.
Dims (run_order 1-9) always finish before Facts (10-19) before Marts (20+).

activities.name: act_run_gold_runner
activities.description: Call pl_gold_runner for the current Gold notebook.

properties.description:
Generic Gold runner — called by pl_gold_dynamic_foreach once per notebook.

Receives parameters from the parent ForEach:
  p_notebook   : notebook name only (e.g. 'nb_gold_dim_station')
  p_run_date   : YYYY-MM-DD or '' for full load
  p_run_type   : 'incremental' | 'full'

Builds the full Databricks workspace path at runtime:
  /Users/hariomsuryawanshi68258@gmail.com/<p_notebook>

This single pipeline replaces individual pl_gold_<entity> pipelines.
Adding a new Gold notebook = INSERT one row in ev_catalog.gold.gold_control.

activities.name: act_run_gold_notebook
activities.description: Execute the Gold notebook whose name comes from the control table row.

properties.description:
End-to-end master pipeline (Day 11).

Flow:
  1. act_list_sources      — nb_list_active_sources reads Bronze control table
  2. act_foreach_source    — ForEach calls pl_bronze_incremental_load_v2 per source
  3. act_silver_dynamic    — ExecutePipeline -> pl_silver_dynamic_foreach
  4. act_gold_dynamic      — ExecutePipeline -> pl_gold_dynamic_foreach

Adding a Bronze source  : INSERT into ev_catalog.ctl.pipeline_control
Adding a Silver entity  : INSERT into ev_catalog.silver.silver_control
Adding a Gold notebook  : INSERT into ev_catalog.gold.gold_control
No ADF changes needed for any of the above.

activities.name: act_list_sources
activities.description: Run nb_list_active_sources — exits with json.dumps([source_names]) string

activities.name: act_foreach_source
activities.description: Iterate sequentially over each active Bronze source.

activities.name: act_silver_dynamic
activities.description: After Bronze completes, run all active Silver notebooks via control table.

activities.name: act_gold_dynamic
activities.description:
After Silver completes, run all active Gold notebooks via control table.
Dims → Facts → Marts order is guaranteed by run_order in gold_control.

activities.name: act_list_silver_notebooks
activities.description: Read control table Silver Databricks Notebook

properties.description:
Triggers the Silver transformation notebook for sl_payments.

p_run_date (optional override):
  - Leave blank when running via trigger  -> notebook receives today's date from TriggerTime
  - Pass YYYY-MM-DD for manual backfill  -> notebook reads that specific Bronze partition

Notebook: /Users/hariomsuryawanshi68258@gmail.com/nb_silver_payments
Sink    : ev_catalog.silver.sl_payments (Delta MERGE on payment_id)

activities.name: act_silver_payments
activities.description:
Runs nb_silver_payments.
p_run_date logic:
  - If pipeline parameter p_run_date is provided -> use it (backfill)
  - Otherwise                                    -> use formatDateTime(pipeline().TriggerTime, 'yyyy-MM-dd') (daily run)
